description: Eastern Power Networks (EPN) Area Operational Boundaries is a dataset listed in UK Power Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by UK Power Networks. Introduction Shapefile showing operational boundaries in the UK Power Networks Eastern Power Networks (EPN) area. Methodological Approach This dataset was extracted from UK Power Networks' internal geospatial mapping database - NetMap. Quality Control Statement The data is provided "as is". Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Supporting Information. The portal shows 2024-08-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ukpn-open-data-portal.
